title: Customization source node
description: A plugin, extension or organization row in a customization list (`.customization-source-node`) whose children are the customizations it supplies: twistie, kind icon, bold label, kind ("Plugin", "Extension", "Organization") and an open (link-external) action shown on hover or focus. Items after it with the `nested` attribute are its children: indented one more level, 32px tall and (prompt files, MCP servers) name only.
usage: Direct child of <vsc-customization-list>, inside a group, followed by its children with `nested`: <vsc-customization-source-node label="Security & Code Quality Plugin" kind="plugin" count="1" open-label="Show Plugin"></vsc-customization-source-node><vsc-customization-item nested name="..."></vsc-customization-item>. Clicking it (not the open action) collapses its children; the open action dispatches `open-source`.

attributes.name: open-label
attributes.description: Shows the open action with this label (e.g. Show Plugin); omit to hide it

sources.note: ITEM_HEIGHT 44, NESTED_ITEM_HEIGHT 32; nested items show only their name

examples.title: Plugin with a nested skill
